Mia (partnerships): Heads-up: starting onboarding with OpenCascadeAI (OCI) — they want to distribute an open model via AWS + GCP marketplaces, bundle with VertexEdge GPU appliance, and enable SI integration with CloudIntegrate. Need alignment on licensing, redistribution, marketplace SKU strategy, and a joint announcement plan. Who can pick up legal + eng checks?
Sam (legal): Adding Sam (legal). Quick Q: are the weights truly permissive (Apache/MIT) or source-available? That determines whether we can repackage for marketplace or need a redistribution addendum. Also need export classification and data provenance statements.
Mia (partnerships): OCI told us "permissive open weights (Apache 2.0) with commercial use allowed" but counsel is looped in and will confirm. They want a bundled SKU so customers can buy Redwood-hosted inference + VertexEdge hw as a single line item.
Leo (product): From product perspective: propose SKU naming convention: `redwood:model:opencascadeai:v1` and bundle as `redwood:bundle:opencascadeai-vertexedge:gpu`. Require explicit model artifacts (hf-style repo or s3), model card, and perf profile (qps, p95, mem). Need quantized variants (fp16, int8) listed separately.
Anita (eng): Engineering needs: canonical model artifact (weights + tokenizer), minimal sanity tests (generation and embedding checks), and a perf runbook for VertexEdge. If VertexEdge requires a custom kernel, we need their runtime/container or a validated image. Also confirm KV-cache compatibility and max-seq-len.
Sam (legal): Actionable legal items: 1) confirm license text (attach SPDX). 2) ask OCI to provide EAR/ITAR classification doc. 3) include a limited indemnity + IP representation clause. If they remain Apache 2.0, marketplace redistribution is straightfoward; if not, require a redistribution addendum. I'll draft redlines.
Chris (devrel): For go-to-market: suggest coordinated 2-week embargo: blog post + marketplace page + VertexEdge social + one joint webinar. Need partner quotes and co-branded assets. Who will own the first draft of copy?
Mia (partnerships): I'll take copy with OCI marketing. Timeline: OCI wants launch in ~6 weeks. Sam: can legal turn around the addendum in ~10 business days if needed?
Sam (legal): If provider certs license and signs our redistribution addendum, 10 business days is realistic. I'll start with our standard distro addendum and drop in OCI specifics.
Anita (eng): For compatibility testing, we'll need a small test harness. Can OCI provide a docker image or HF repo link to run a lightweight perf job on VertexEdge emulator? Also ask for a small prompt set (5-10 prompts) for qualitative checks.
Leo (product): Also need pricing guidance from VertexEdge: is this a rev-share bundle or referral? We should lock on list price + discount tiers for marketplace SKU. Partnerships should loop in sales ops to compute billing mapping.
Mia (partnerships): Noted. I'll ping sales-ops after legal confirms redistribution.
Sam (legal): Draft snippet I'm proposing for redistribution addendum (very rough):
```
Redistribution Addendum (excerpt):
Provider grants Redwood a non-exclusive, worldwide, sublicensable right to redistribute Provider Model Artifacts under the Provider-specified permissive license (e.g., Apache-2.0). Provider represents no export restrictions apply beyond those disclosed; Provider will provide EAR classification and attribution text. Redwood will include Provider attribution in marketplace listing and product docs.
```
Mia (partnerships): That looks fine as a starting point — thanks.
Chris (devrel): Suggest we create a joint checklist for the launch. Quick draft:
- Legal signoff (redistribution + export)
- Model artifacts (weights + tokenizer + quantized versions)
- Perf profile + test harness
- Marketplace SKU & pricing mapping
- Hardware image / VertexEdge runtime validation
- Co-branded assets + partner quotes
- Announcement draft + embargo date
- SI integration docs for CloudIntegrate

Anita (eng): One more tech note: ask OCI for a compatibility matrix with sequence length, supported ops (rotary/flash attention), and whether they have fp16 kernels. That will speed our runtime validation.
Sam (legal): I'll attach our standard redistribution addendum and a checklist of docs we need. Expect redline by EOD.
announce-bot: Reminder: draft announcement calendar slot open 2026-04-28.
Mia (partnerships): Action items so far:
- Mia: collect OCI marketing assets + partner quote (due in 5 business days)
- Sam: send redistribution addendum redlines (due in 2 business days)
- Anita: define test harness + perf template and share scripts (due in 7 business days)
- Leo: finalize SKU naming + pricing model with sales-ops (due in 7 business days)
- Chris: prepare announcement checklist and draft templates (due in 10 business days)
Please react with :thumbsup: if this plan works or add comments.
Sam (legal): :thumbsup: will review draft later today.
Leo (product): :thumbsup:
Anita (eng): :thumbsup:
Mia (partnerships): thanks all — I'll schedule a short sync next week if needed.
